newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO JUNE SALES UP 6.1 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: KESKO JUNE SALES UP 6.1 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy said in a statement on Tuesday that group sales excluding value-added-tax (VAT) increased 6.1 percent year-on-year in June to 2.85 billion markka.
Kesko's daily goods sales rose 9.5 percent in June on the year-ago period to 1.56 billion markka while sales of hardware and agriculture goods fell 0.6 percent to 673 million markka.
Durable goods sales rose 4.4 percent to 330 million markka.
The group's January-June sales rose 22.5 percent year-on-year to 17.77 billion markka.
